newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.38 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.38 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 14.0 trillion lire 17-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 7.38 percent, compared with 7.83 percent at the previous repo tender on December 9, the Bank said.
The average rate was 7.58 percent against 7.90 percent at the last repurchase pact for 12.0 trillion lire and seven days.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for resale on January 2. The Bank said it received 40 bids of which 39 were met in full and one in part.
